stories.style: First-person present, spare concrete sentences; no access to other minds.
stories.prior_story: Mara has the brass key. The archive door is locked. Iven waits outside. The ferry leaves at dawn.

synthetic_scenes: I turn the brass key in the archive door. Salt catches in the lock. I lean harder, and the door opens. Iven waits outside while I cross the threshold.
I find the ledger beneath a folded map. The ferry leaves at dawn. I copy the missing name and close the book. I carry the name to Iven.

stories.title: The Last Signal
stories.style: Third-person limited past through Tavi; restrained concrete imagery and short sentences.
stories.prior_story: Tavi carried a red lantern. The canal gate was closed. Ren stayed on the eastern bank. The radio was broken.

scene_plan.title: Signal 1
scene_plan.outcome: Ren stayed on the eastern bank, beyond her reach.

scene_plan.title: Signal 2
scene_plan.outcome: The gate opened before the water reached Ren.
beats: She found the manual lever beneath the steps

synthetic_scenes: Tavi raised the red lantern. The canal gate was closed. Rain tapped the glass as she checked the catch. Ren stayed on the eastern bank, beyond her reach.
She found the manual lever beneath the steps. The radio was broken, but the signal rope held. She pulled twice and waited. The gate opened before the water reached Ren.
